chapter: Ridgley, La Vida, Piron and the Minstrels
title: Career sequence after Perez: Ridgley, La Vida, Piron
summary: Williams recounts going from Perez to La Vida, Ridgley's band, back to La Vida, then Piron from 1932 to 1935.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: After you left Perez, who did you play with? After I left Manny Perez. You mean the orchestra when I was playing on the roof garden? Mm-hmm. I told you I went down to La Vida. You went to La Vida. And then? Got with Ridgely. You with... With Bebe Ridgely's Tuxedo. That band split up at the time. Yeah, see that band split up at the time.
The Celestan's part of them or something? That's right, that's right. And how long were you with Ridgely?

I was Ridgely about a year. See, 28. Then I went to La Vida in 29. There you see. Stayed in La Vida's, 29. 30. 31. 32. I went to Piran. I went to Piran from 32 to 35. Went up on the boat with Piran. Made a trip with Piran in 34 on the JS.
